answer_1.quote: We evaluate models' performance on speech instruction following, which requires generating appropriate textual responses ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to spoken instructions (textual replies)

answer_2.quote: Closed-ended instruction questions objectively evaluate SpeechLLM's ability ... using Prompt-level strict-accuracy, Prompt-level loose-accuracy, Instruction-level strict-accuracy, and Instruction-level loose-accuracy.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4o as the evaluator and the evaluation metrics for open-ended instructions are consistent with closed-ended instructions ... human evaluations and compare them with GPT-4o judgments, demonstrating consistent agreement.

answer_4.quote: A total of 20 evaluators participated in this assessment... they were required to make their assessments by selecting either "YES" or "NO" to indicate whether the response was factually correct.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators judged factual correctness of model responses by answering YES or NO.
